information:
Welcome to FMC Norway 2026

This competition will have three rounds of 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, held in two different cities at the same time, Oslo and Trondheim. Each round will have a mean of 3, for a total of 9 attempts. 

## Note that this competition does not hold normal 3x3
